title: Simulated Corne — English (lessons 1–2 as a worked example)
notes: Scenario B of docs/learning/lesson-rules.md, first two lessons only. The combos K+Y (Esc) and M+C (Enter) are not drilled.

lessons.title: New keys: Home row
lessons.guidance: Rest the left fingers on S H N T (pinky to index) and the right fingers on A E O I (index to pinky). Tap each key and let it go: holding S gives a layer, and holding H, N, T, A, E, O or I gives a modifier. Space is the left thumb.

lessons.title: New keys: r and d
lessons.guidance: R is the left middle finger, up one row from N. D is the right middle finger, up one row from E. Come straight back to the home row after each.
